title: ModelEntry
description: A model in the Model Registry (artifacts/registry/models/<id>.json). Train registers fine-tuned runs; Eval appends evaluation summaries. The source of truth is services/registry/src/agritune_registry/store.py.

hf_id.description: hf_base: the checkpoint; hf_adapter: the base checkpoint it was trained on.

adapter_uri.description: hf_adapter: artifact path of the LoRA adapter.

ollama_tag.description: kind ollama, or an hf model exported to Ollama (then usable in the playground).

api_model.description: kind api: the provider's model id.

train_preset.description: Set when the Train service can fine-tune this model.

parent.description: Registry id of the model a fine-tune started from.

lineage.description: dataset, task, run_id, preset, base_model, mlflow_run_id

options.description: Provider request options, e.g. {"effort": "low"} for Claude.

prompt_tier.description: Prompt variant for tasks whose rows carry several (e.g. Strong Hire's small-model prompts). Null: the default prompt.
